raw_segments.text: French king, think we King Harry strong, and princes look you strongly armed to meet him.
The kindred of him hath been fleshed upon us, and he has bred out of that bloody strain
that haunted us in our familiar paths.
Witness our too much memorable shame when Cressy Battle fatally was struck, and all
our princes captived by the hand of that black name, Edward, Black Prince of Wales, whilst
that his mountain sire, on mountain standing, up in the air, crowned with the golden sun,
saw his heroical seed, and smilled to see him, mangle the work of nature and deface
the patterns that by God and by French fathers had twenty years been made.
This is a stem of that victorious stock, and let us fear the native mightiness and fate
